units.source_text: 初冬阴郁的天空下，寒冷的微风带着几分咸味，从宽阔的军用公路吹了过去。

en.t: Under the gloomy sky of early winter, a cold breeze with a faint taste of salt blew across the broad military road.

units.source_text: 与其说是海的气味，莫如说是无机物质的铁锈般的气味。

en.t: Rather than the smell of the sea, it was more like the rusty odor of some inorganic substance.

units.source_text: 像运河似的狭窄的海，深深地通到市镇的中心，

en.t: The narrow sea, like a canal, reached deep into the center of the town,

units.source_text: 死一般静止的水面、系在岸边的美国小舰艇……

en.t: with its deathly still surface and the small American naval craft moored along the shore...

units.source_text: 但是过分周到的卫生管理却使人感到仿佛剥夺了过去的军港杂乱的肉体的活力，

en.t: but the excessively thorough sanitary management made it seem as though the chaotic physical vitality of the old military port had been stripped away,

units.source_text: 把整个市街变成了医院。

en.t: turning the entire town into a hospital.
